Context: Household task management app for couples called HoneyDo2Done with a modern, dark-themed aesthetic.
Description of the screen: The 'Add Task' screen for HoneyDo2Done. It features a full-height bottom drawer or a clean modal overlay against the deep charcoal background. The UI is very minimal with rounded corners and warm honey gold accents for the primary action button. The typography is clean sans-serif. It feels effortless and satisfying to use.
